text: Do you have an audience with me?
zh: 你是获准来觐见的吗？

text: Do you know something about the Champion's Coin?
zh: 您知道冠军硬币的事吗？

text: I found the King's Ruby.
zh: 我找到了国王的红宝石。

text: Regarding Dhul'oq...
zh: 关于杜尔奥克……

text: No.
zh: 没有。

text: I am on my way.
zh: 我这就去。

text: The Champion's Coin?
zh: 冠军硬币？

text:
Well, that doesn't mean anything to me.
I don't assume this is a normal coin, either.
zh:
唔，我从未听说过这东西。
想必这也不是一枚寻常的硬币。

text:
If so, I have to disappoint you.
There are no things such as #:sacred coins:#.
zh:
若是那样，我只能让你失望了。
世上并没有#:神圣硬币:#这种东西。

text: Talk to my advisor, if you need anything else.
zh: 若还有别的需要，去找我的顾问谈。

text:
The King's Ruby?
But it was entombed with my father!
zh:
国王的红宝石？
可它是随我父王一同下葬的！

text: What do you have to tell me?
zh: 你有什么要禀报的？

text: My advisor will take care of your requests.
zh: 你的请求，我的顾问会处理。

text: You may go!
zh: 你可以退下了！

text:
Tell me!
How did you get your hands on this?
zh:
说！
你是怎么拿到这东西的？

text: *report on the fight with the skeleton
zh: *讲述与骷髅战斗的经过

text: Then I must be mistaken.
zh: 那想必是我弄错了。

text:
You fool!
I am not one to be trifled with!
zh:
蠢货！
我可不是任人戏弄的！

text:
I find it hard to believe you.
Let me see the ruby!
zh:
我很难相信你的话。
让我看看那颗红宝石！

text:
Indeed!
That's my father's ruby.
zh:
没错！
这正是我父王的红宝石。

text: It seems to me that you're speaking the truth, even if I don't like it.
zh: 看来你说的是实话，尽管我并不乐意听。

text:
Nevertheless!
This ruby ​​has been in my family for generations and will continue to be.
zh:
尽管如此！
这颗红宝石在我的家族中传承了数代，今后也将如此。

text: Especially when it comes to my family!
zh: 尤其是事关我的家族！

text: In return, I express my gratitude to you, and you shall choose your own reward.
zh: 作为回报，我向你致谢，并许你自选一份奖赏。

text: I want to join the Royal Guard!
zh: 我想加入皇家卫队！

text: How about some gold?
zh: 赏些金币如何？

text: There's nothing I need.
zh: 我什么都不需要。

text:
So be it!
Edmon, my trusted advisor, shall raise you to stand among the Royal Guard!
zh:
那就这样定了！
我信任的顾问埃德蒙将擢升你为皇家卫队的一员！

text:
Well, then my thanks will have to suffice!
I won't forget that.
zh:
那么，就请收下我的谢意吧！
此事我不会忘记。

text:
Very well.
This shall be your reward.
zh:
很好。
这便是你的奖赏。

text: What is it that you have found?
zh: 你发现了什么？

text: I defeated the Keeper in the tower.
zh: 我击败了塔中的守护者。

text: Dhul'oq ascended into the sky.
zh: 杜尔奥克升上了天空。

text: A sacred stone might be with Queen Heliria.
zh: 一块圣石可能在赫莉莉亚王后那里。

text: The portal to Dhul'oq is active.
zh: 通往杜尔奥克的传送门已经激活。

text: There's nothing else I know.
zh: 我知道的就这些了。

text: We'll speak again when you have news of Dhul'oq.
zh: 等你有了杜尔奥克的消息，我们再谈。

text:
The Keeper, you say?
So the tower isn't abandoned after all.
zh:
你说守护者？
看来那座塔并未被废弃。

text:
Interesting.
When we last approached it, the doors to the tower refused to open.
zh:
有意思。
我们上次靠近时，塔门怎么也打不开。

text: I wonder what could have opened them.
zh: 真不知是什么把门打开了。

text:
What is this nonsense?
A city rising into the sky?
zh:
这是什么胡话？
一座城升上了天空？

text:
Still...
It would explain the shattered ruins we found.
zh:
不过……
这倒能解释我们发现的那些破碎的废墟。

text: Hard to believe, but you don't seem to be lying.
zh: 难以置信，但你看上去不像在撒谎。

text: Is there a way to reach the city in the sky?
zh: 有办法抵达那座天空之城吗？

text: A portal can be activated with three sacred stones.
zh: 用三块圣石可以激活一座传送门。

text:
A portal?
Unfortunately, I don't know about any sacred stones.
zh:
传送门？
可惜，我对什么圣石一无所知。

text:
Report back any information you find about them.
Maybe I'll be able to help you with your search.
zh:
你若查到任何相关的线索，就来向我禀报。
或许我能助你一臂之力。

text: Queen Heliria has been buried in the crypt for generations. What makes you think she had such a stone?
zh: 赫莉莉亚王后葬在墓穴中已有数代之久。你凭什么认为她有这样一块石头？

text:
Indeed, I remember!
A scholar entrusted her with an azure stone, which she kept until her death.
zh:
确实，我想起来了！
曾有位学者将一块蔚蓝之石托付给她，她一直保存到离世。

text: There's mention of an azure stone in a book
zh: 有本书里提到了一块蔚蓝之石

text: It probably is still down in the crypt with her.
zh: 那石头多半还随她留在墓穴里。

text: Take this key. It grants access to the crypt through the barracks.
zh: 拿上这把钥匙。凭它可以从兵营进入墓穴。

text: Be careful down there. One of my ancestors installed traps to keep petty thieves away.
zh: 下面要多加小心。我的一位先祖设下了防范窃贼的机关。

text:
So, you've found the sacred stones?
Well done!
zh:
这么说，你找到了圣石？
干得好！

text: As a member of the royal guard, you shall receive this armor to honor your deeds.
zh: 作为皇家卫队的一员，你将获授这套护甲，以表彰你的功绩。

text: Tell me, what shall be your reward?
zh: 说吧，你想要什么奖赏？

text: Gold coins would be quite good.
zh: 金币就很好。

text: These coins should help you ready yourself for future challenges.
zh: 这些金币应该能助你为今后的挑战做好准备。

text:
Now move aside!
I need to plan a journey to the city Dhul'oq.
zh:
现在退下吧！
我要筹划前往杜尔奥克城的行程。
